function.name: launch_application
function.description: Launch a desktop application by its name or path.

app_name.description: Name or full path of the application (e.g., 'Calculator', 'C:\Program Files\App\app.exe').

function.name: search_web
function.description: Perform a web search and return the top results with snippets.

num_results.description: Number of search results to return (1-10).

function.name: get_system_info
function.description: Retrieve real‑time system information (CPU, memory, disk, battery, etc.).

info_type.description: Type of system information to retrieve.

function.name: execute_command
function.description: Execute a shell command on the local OS (with sandbox restrictions).

working_directory.description: Optional working directory for the command.

function.name: remember_fact
function.description: Store a fact or piece of information in long‑term memory for later retrieval.

key.description: A label or key for the fact.

function.name: recall_fact
function.description: Retrieve a previously stored fact from memory by key or query.

semantic_query.description: Natural language query to find semantically similar memories.

function.name: open_url
function.description: Open a URL in the default web browser on the user's machine.

url.description: The full URL to open (e.g., https://example.com).
